summary: Verified desktop mega-menu centering & stationary bounds on AlterX homepage header. Tested all 6 nav items at 1440x850, 1366x850, 1280x850. Menu is perfectly viewport-centered (diff 0.00px vs +/-2px tolerance) for every item at every width. Outer bounds are fully stationary when switching Products -> Developers -> Company (left variance 0.00px, width variance 0.00px). Header layout (logo left, nav center, Try Alter Engine CTA right) intact; mega-menu-featured and 5 mega-link-* items render inside panel.
action_items: Minor: The review_request specified nav trigger testid 'nav-trigger-alter-engine', but the actual implementation uses NAV key 'engine' -> data-testid 'nav-trigger-engine' (see /app/frontend/src/content/navigation.js line 4). Not a bug — tests still pass with the real key. Consider aligning the key to 'alter-engine' if you want the testid to match the request/spec verbatim.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mega-menu bug is fully fixed. NAV key for Alter Engine is 'engine' (not 'alter-engine'); use data-testid='nav-trigger-engine' when testing that item. Menu opens on hover after ~70ms hover-intent; wait ~450ms. Menu is position:fixed centered via left:50% + Framer Motion x:'-50%'.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously Tailwind class '-translate-x-1/2' was overridden by Framer Motion's inline transform (translateY). Fix in Header.jsx composes centering via Framer Motion x:'-50%' with y slide, plus position:fixed left:50%, giving stable viewport centering independent of the hovered trigger.
